caveats: Profiling is a separate diagnostic run; ORT event durations are not hardware GPU timestamps.
ORT reports estimated copy events; their durations include queue waits/synchronization and are not isolated bus timings.
The graph still has CPU fallback work, notably LogSoftmax, dynamic shape/index operations, and small border-mode GridSample nodes.
The profile does not prove shared memory between ONNX Runtime WebGPU and the separate wgpu-py context.
This is a 640x360 global network inference on 4K source images, not native-4K network inference.
The five-repeat timings use the final composite CLI flag from the original source export; the separately profiled graph differs only in an ONNX metadata string.

limitations: ORT trace durations are event durations, not hardware GPU timestamps.
Memcpy event durations may include synchronization or queue waits.
Tensor byte counts are estimates from static input/output shapes.
The trace does not provide peak GPU allocation or live-buffer memory.
